propositions: CodeQL alerts 83–87 for rule py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data are false positives due to taint over-approximation; the logged expressions do not contain or leak credential values
Alerts 86–87 log family category names from SECRET_PATTERNS (e.g. 'Anthropic API key'), not secret values, because SecretFinding dataclass structurally has no value field
Alerts 83–85 log command-line echoes (unknown command names, unrecognized options, surplus arguments) to stderr, not the --allow-secret-pattern override reason, which is stripped before logging
Regression tests must pin the invariant that family names are logged without leaking the secret value in forced-write routes and that usage errors never echo the override reason
All 5 alerts must be dismissed via code-scanning API with false-positive justification and evidence comments; zero open alerts for this rule after dismissal
